versions.changelog:
WeChat-Article-Style v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "公众号文章创作风格指南（大象风格）".
- Provides a detailed 7-part article structure, covering pain point introduction, solution announcement, feature list, step-by-step tutorial, real-world cases, advanced tips, and FAQ/data/summary.
- Defines clear formatting rules: emoji use, bold keywords, code blocks, data tables, and standardized author signature.
- Includes precise content, style, flow, and formatting guidelines to ensure practical, engaging, and professional WeChat/knowledge sharing articles.
- Supplies word count recommendations, SEO hints, applicable scenarios, and a pre-publication checklist for quality assurance.
